stories.title: Primaire à gauche : Raphaël Glucksmann, traité de « stagiaire » par Ségolène Royal, la renvoie à des postes « quémandés pendant quarante-cinq ans »

en.title: Left primary: Raphaël Glucksmann, called an "intern" by Ségolène Royal, fires back at her "positions begged for forty-five years"
en.summary: Three weeks before the left primary's first round, tensions escalate between candidates as former socialist presidential contender Ségolène Royal criticized Glucksmann's lack of political experience.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Présidentielle 2027 : «Je n’ai pas quémandé des postes depuis 45 ans, moi», Raphaël Glucksmann répond à Ségolène Royal

en.title: LIVE - 2027 presidential election: "I haven't begged for positions for 45 years," Raphaël Glucksmann responds to Ségolène Royal
en.summary: Ségolène Royal, a former presidential finalist, called Glucksmann, her rival in the social-democratic primary, an "intern" in politics, prompting his rebuttal.

stories.title: Russie : le parti de Vladimir Poutine décroche un nombre record de sièges à la Douma

en.title: Russia: Vladimir Putin's party secures record number of seats in the Duma
en.summary: With over 95% of polling stations counted, Putin's United Russia party obtained an overwhelming majority in the 450-seat lower chamber of Parliament.

stories.title: Prix des carburants : le gouvernement envisage une «aide supplémentaire» selon le ministre du Travail

en.title: Fuel prices: government considering "additional aid" according to Labour minister
en.summary: The Labour minister announced on September 21 that the government is considering supplementary support measures for citizens facing rising fuel costs ahead of a meeting at the Prime Minister's office.

stories.title: Prix des carburants : «Il y aura de nouvelles aides» mais pas «de baisse des taxes généralisée», prévient le gouvernement

en.title: Fuel prices: "There will be new aid" but not "broad tax cuts", government warns
en.summary: The French government is working on additional support measures to address rising fuel prices at the pump, with details to be announced within days.

stories.title: Prix des carburants : le gouvernement évoque « de nouvelles aides pour les Français qui travaillent »

en.title: Fuel prices: government mentions "new aid for French people who work"
en.summary: Following diesel reaching a record 2.41 euros per liter, a government meeting is being held to design a new assistance package to be announced in coming days.

stories.title: Le « bureau de la remigration » de Donald Trump a expulsé plus de 25 000 étrangers vers des pays tiers, révèle le consortium Forbidden Stories

en.title: Trump's "remigration office" expelled more than 25,000 foreigners to third countries, Forbidden Stories consortium reveals
en.summary: An investigation by 72 journalists across 15 countries found that the U.S. government allocated at least 410 million dollars to host countries and UN agencies to facilitate expulsions.

stories.title: Ségolène Royal rappelée à l'ordre par la commission d'organisation de la primaire socialiste après avoir comparé Raphaël Glucksmann à un "stagiaire"

en.title: Ségolène Royal reprimanded by socialist primary organizers after comparing Raphaël Glucksmann to an "intern"
en.summary: The head of the primary's organizing commission called on Royal to adopt a respectful attitude toward the democratic process and urged all participants to maintain a spirit of solidarity.

stories.title: La riposte de Raphaël Glucksmann à Ségolène Royal qui le relègue au rang de «stagiaire» : «Moi je ne quémande pas des postes depuis 45 ans»

en.title: Raphaël Glucksmann's response to Ségolène Royal relegating him to 'intern' status: 'I haven't been begging for positions for 45 years'
en.summary: In a radio appearance, the socialist primary frontrunner criticized his rival's Macron connections since 2017 after she attacked him in print. Election organizers expressed frustration with Royal's remarks.

stories.title: La Chine confirme une visite d’Etat de son président, Xi Jinping, aux Etats-Unis cette semaine pour rencontrer Donald Trump

en.title: China confirms a state visit by its president, Xi Jinping, to the United States this week to meet Donald Trump
en.summary: China announced a second 2026 summit between the two leaders aimed at discussing strategic stability in bilateral and international relations.

stories.title: Les Etats-Unis ont expulsé plus de 25 000 étrangers dans plus d’une vingtaine de pays tiers depuis le retour de Trump au pouvoir

en.title: The United States has expelled more than 25,000 foreigners to over twenty third countries since Trump's return to power
en.summary: Most of these deportations went to Mexico, according to reporting by the international journalist consortium Forbidden Stories.

stories.title: Donald Trump va rencontrer Emmanuel Macron à New York lundi soir en marge de l'Assemblée générale des Nations Unies

en.title: Donald Trump will meet Emmanuel Macron in New York on Monday evening during the United Nations General Assembly
en.summary: The meeting is scheduled for 23:35 Paris time, according to the American president's published schedule.

stories.title: Réduction de la dette : l’Italie peut-elle inspirer la France ?

en.title: Debt reduction: Can Italy inspire France?
en.summary: Italy has reduced its deficit and regained market confidence over fifteen years despite long being considered a poor performer in Europe. The question is whether France could follow Italy's example in addressing its own debt challenges.

stories.title: OPINION. « De l'Allemagne, ou le prix de la vertu mal comptée » (Michel Santi)

en.title: Germany, or the price of poorly calculated virtue
en.summary: Germany has protected its finances while neglecting the foundations of its prosperity, with major companies like Volkswagen and BASF reducing German operations and investing abroad, leaving the country unable to relocate critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Marre des hallucinations des chatbots ? NewsGuard lance un assistant IA dédié d'actualité basé sur une information « neutre » et « sourcée »

en.title: Tired of chatbot hallucinations? NewsGuard launches an AI news assistant based on "neutral" and "sourced" information
en.summary: NewsGuard has unveiled an AI assistant that draws exclusively from 12,000 verified news sources and shares half of its revenue with the cited publishers.

stories.title: Il y a 45 ans : Auréole 3, un satellite franco-soviétique pour étudier la magnétosphère terrestre

en.title: 45 years ago: Auréole 3, a Franco-Soviet satellite to study Earth's magnetosphere
en.summary: On September 21, 1981, a Soviet launcher placed Auréole 3 into orbit, the sixth satellite from Franco-Soviet cooperation, as part of the Arcad 3 program to study the planet's magnetosphere.

stories.title: Ukraine, Iran, clash entre le Canada et les États-Unis : une assemblée générale de l’ONU sous haute tension

en.title: Ukraine, Iran, clash between Canada and the United States: a UN General Assembly under high tension
en.summary: World leaders are gathering this week in New York for the UN General Assembly. The atmosphere is expected to be tense amid multiple global crises.
